tasks.short: Enter new patron registrations, check ID and confirm registration, update contact details, and remove inactive patron records.

steps.what: Library technician enters patrons' records from paper registration forms
Library technician checks ID and confirms the registration
Library technician updates patrons' addresses and contact details on request
Library technician removes inactive patron records

tasks.design: Patrons register and update their own details in their online library account ({OTHER}), so the technician does not type paper forms; the technician checks ID at the first visit. A scheduled job lists records inactive beyond the retention period, and the technician reviews the list before deletion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Registrations and changes were typed from paper forms and old records cleaned by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Library systems offer self-registration, online accounts and scheduled clean-up lists.
tasks.still_hard: Some patrons cannot use online forms.
tasks.human_edge: Helping a newcomer without papers get a library card.
tasks.altitude: The technician checks and helps instead of typing.

evidence.claim: Library systems can run scheduled notices and self-service accounts.
Basic administration is kept seven years and must stay usable at an audit.

assumptions: Boundary: from the registration form to records cleaned; lending is outside.
Input contract: online accounts enabled; fallback is paper forms.
Patrons fill the online form in about the time the paper form took; updates add a little patron time.
ID checks stay at the desk.
research_questions: What share of patrons register online?

incremental.description: Library technician helps patrons who cannot register online.
Patrons update their own details online.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many patrons needing help; high: mostly online registrations.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Talk with teachers and students about their needs, search the catalogue and databases, gather physical materials, and compile reading lists for projects.

steps.what: Library technician talks with teachers and students about their project needs
Library technician searches the catalogue and databases to locate materials

loop.input: The project question and the library's catalogue and licensed databases.
loop.output: A short list of matching items with a one-line summary and link each.
loop.check: Code drops any item that does not resolve to a catalogue record or DOI; the technician reviews the list.
loop.stop: One search per question; if nothing resolves, the technician searches by hand.
loop.why_not_simpler: Students ask in their own words; keyword search misses items described differently.

steps.what: Library technician gathers physical materials from the shelves
Library technician compiles reading lists to help complete special projects

tasks.design: A research assistant in the discovery system ({OTHER}) answers the project question from the catalogue and licensed databases with links, and code drops any item that does not resolve to a record; the technician reviews the list. Selected records are exported as a formatted reading list instead of typing citations. Talking with teachers and students and gathering physical materials stay with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each question was searched by keyword and lists typed by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Discovery systems answer questions from indexed sources with links.
tasks.still_hard: Students bring chatbot references to works that do not exist.
tasks.human_edge: Finding the right book for a struggling reader's project.
tasks.altitude: The technician reviews results instead of searching from scratch.

evidence.claim: Primo Research Assistant answers reference questions from the top five abstracts with source links.
The Library of Virginia estimates 15 percent of emailed reference questions are ChatGPT-generated, some citing invented works.

assumptions: Boundary: from the project request to the reading list; teaching is outside.
Input contract: discovery system licensed; fallback is keyword search.
research_questions: How often does the check drop an item?

incremental.description: Library technician reports wrong results to the system manager.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: unusual topics; high: common school projects.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile circulation statistics, keep equipment loan lists, record damaged or missing materials, and check inventory on the shelves.

steps.what: Library technician compiles circulation statistics in spreadsheets
Library technician maintains equipment loan records on paper lists
Library technician records damaged or missing materials
Library technician checks inventory on the shelves

tasks.design: A usage dashboard in the library system ({OTHER}) gives circulation figures per branch, collection and period, so statistics are not compiled in spreadsheets. Laptops and cameras are catalogued as items with barcodes and lent like books. Shelf inventory uses a handheld RFID reader that lists missing and misplaced items. Recording damage stays with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Statistics were compiled by hand, equipment tracked on paper and shelves checked item by item.
tasks.enabler_now: Library systems give usage dashboards; RFID readers scan shelves.
tasks.still_hard: Older items have no RFID tag.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting a damaged book before the next reader does.
tasks.altitude: The technician acts on lists instead of compiling them.

evidence.claim: Library systems can give usage dashboards and lend equipment as barcoded items; RFID readers scan shelves.
System logs that check staff output need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the period end to inventory checked; weeding decisions are outside.
Input contract: items tagged; fallback is item-by-item checks.
Recording damage stays with the technician.
research_questions: Do missing items get found sooner?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small branches; high: large collections with much equipment.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Speak to disruptive patrons, call security or police when needed, write the incident report, and block the patron's account under the policy.

steps.what: Library technician takes actions to halt disruption by problem patrons
Library technician calls security or police
Library technician writes the incident report on paper
Library technician blocks the patron's account under the policy

tasks.design: Incident reports are a short form in the library system ({OTHER}) with fixed fields linked to the patron record, so the manager sees past incidents when deciding on a ban, instead of paper reports in a folder. Handling disruption, calling for help and blocking accounts stay with the technician under the policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Incident reports were written on paper and kept in a folder.
tasks.enabler_now: Library systems can hold incident forms linked to patron records.
tasks.still_hard: Incidents with unknown people cannot be linked to a record.
tasks.human_edge: Calming a patron in distress without escalating.

evidence.claim: Library systems can hold incident forms linked to patron records.

assumptions: Boundary: from the disruption to the account blocked; legal action is outside.
Input contract: incident form set up; fallback is paper.
Incident data are kept only as long as the policy allows.

incremental.description: Library technician learns the incident form.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few incidents; high: busy city branches.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The library technician keeps helping patrons, students and teachers and handling incidents; typing forms, keyword searching, statistics and paper lists shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A technician with more time for readers.
